idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; an actor is a heap node in its worker's slot table, a message moves one heap payload by pointer; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. An actor is one `new`, one slot and one `delete`, a message one ring push of a pointer to the values it owns: the floor for moving data between actors that are created per split

a child is allocated on its parent's worker (id = slot * cores + worker) and the root's two seeds on workers 0 and 1, the same static placement qb's addRefActor has: with cores=2 each half of the first split is sorted on its own worker and never rebalanced, so this floor bounds the placing frameworks and NOT the pools
cores=1 is one thread with every node in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable, which at cores=2 happens when one half finishes before the other
